badges.name: Geocaching
badges.description: Discover the exciting adventure of geocaching, where you can enjoy the freedom of being outside and identifying new places.

requirements.title: GPS Knowledge
requirements.text: Show that you know about the Global Positioning System (GPS)
subRequirements: Explain how GPS works
Explain ownership and control of the system
Explain its benefits to society
Explain what factors affect its accuracy

requirements.title: GPS Programming
subRequirements: Find your location (grid reference, plus latitude and longitude) and record it
Enter the latitude and longitude coordinates of a nearby point and navigate to the waypoint
Enter the grid reference of a local landmark and navigate to the waypoint
Walk on a bearing using the GPS and a map

requirements.title: Geocaching Awareness
requirements.text: Show that you know about the sport of geocaching
subRequirements: Explain what geocaching is and how it started
Explain the different types of geocaches
Explain the meaning of the terms 'trackable', 'TB', 'coin', 'muggle', 'DNF', 'FTF'
Describe the geocaching etiquette and how to practise it safely

requirements.title: Geocaching Account
requirements.text: With appropriate permission, set up a geocaching account
subRequirements: Create a geocaching account with a responsible adult
Understand and explain the privacy and safety guidelines
Find out about geocaches in your local area

requirements.title: Finding Geocaches
subRequirements: Use a GPS device or smartphone app to locate five different geocaches
For each cache, record the cache name, GC code, and date found
Explain the type and size of each cache found
Log your finds online (with appropriate permission)

requirements.title: Creating a Cache
requirements.text: With appropriate permission, hide a geocache
subRequirements: Find a suitable location for hiding a cache
Prepare a suitable container and contents
Take accurate GPS readings of the location
Submit the cache for publication (following the guidelines)

requirements.title: Trackables
subRequirements: Explain what a trackable is and how it works
Discover a trackable in a cache or online
Log a trackable and understand its mission
Move a trackable to help it on its journey

requirements.title: Geocaching Event
requirements.text: Take part in a geocaching event or activity
subRequirements: Participate in a geocaching event or organise a geocaching activity for your troop
Share your geocaching experiences with others
Teach basic geocaching skills to younger scouts or new members

badges.name: Gardener
badges.description: With a splash of water and a ray of sunshine, you can grow flowers, plants and trees. Bring the forest home.

requirements.title: Trees Through the Seasons
requirements.text: Find out what happens to trees in each of the four seasons

requirements.title: Gardening Tools
requirements.text: Learn what tools you need to garden and how to use some of the tools safely

requirements.title: What Plants Need
requirements.text: Find out what plants need to grow

requirements.title: Growing Plants
requirements.text: Help to look after a garden or allotment for two months (or grow 3 plants in pots)

requirements.title: Keeping Records
requirements.text: Keep a record of what you have done
